goal: Make stale runtime generation failures recover quickly and safely through the existing worker retry loop. Classify the stale-generation error as a bounded transient retry hint without retrying inside the provider mutation call or bypassing operation idempotency.
context: Workers already persist failures and reconstruct Container.Runtime on a later recovery attempt. Preserve that architecture. Add a small cross-package retry-delay contract in worker or another non-cyclic package, make ErrRuntimeGenerationObsolete expose a short bounded retry delay, and make FailureStore honor that hint while retaining exponential backoff for all other errors. No immediate inline retry, no provider call duplication, no schema change.
